title: Correction
hook: Did the story change, or did price move back?

launchpad.outcome: Tell a correction from a reversal by reading structure, not candle color.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Red candles after a bullish indication: panic, or read the structure?

pauses.text: Bullish indication ✓. Then three bearish candles.

options.label: Panic, it’s red!
options.feedback: Red candles aren’t a verdict. Read the structure.

asks.prompt: Did the story automatically turn bearish?

options.label: Yes, three red candles
options.feedback: You noticed the pullback. Did price change the story, or move back inside it?

options.label: The higher low broke
options.feedback: Look again: the HL is still intact.

options.label: Price moved back, but the supporting higher low is intact

pauses.after: BULLISH INDICATION ✓ · CORRECTION IN PROGRESS ● · CONTINUATION ○

end.card:
A correction is price moving back.
A reversal is price changing the story.

slides.title: Correction vs reversal

left.title: Moving back
items: Price moves against the current directional sequence
The relevant supporting structure stays intact

right.title: Changing the story
items: Price changes the information that supported the directional story
Not one universal candle rule: read the structure

slides.principle: A correction is price moving back. A reversal is price changing the story.

slides.title: Which one is still a correction?

ask.prompt: Which one is still a correction?

options.label: A: the higher low held
options.why: Price moved back, structure held. Correction.

options.label: B
options.feedback: B closed below the higher low and kept building lower. That changed the story.

options.label: Both, they both went down
options.feedback: Same direction of candles, different structure.

slides.quote: A pullback isn’t a verdict. Ask whether price changed the story, or simply moved back inside it.

slides.prompt: What’s the difference between a correction and a reversal?
slides.modelAnswer: A correction moves against the move while the supporting structure stays intact. A reversal changes the information that supported the directional story.

remember: A correction is price moving back. A reversal is price changing the story.
